passages.text: The rise of artificial intelligence has prompted both excitement and anxiety in equal measure. Proponents argue that AI will revolutionize industries, streamline processes, and create new categories of jobs that we cannot yet imagine. Critics, however, warn that the rapid deployment of AI systems could lead to widespread job displacement, particularly among workers whose roles involve routine, repetitive tasks. What remains clear is that the technology which once seemed confined to the realm of science fiction has now become an inescapable part of our daily lives, raising questions about privacy, accountability, and the very definition of human capability.

Climate change has emerged as one of the most pressing challenges of our time, demanding coordinated action from governments, corporations, and individuals alike. While some progress has been made in reducing carbon emissions in certain sectors, the overall trajectory remains concerning. Scientists warn that without immediate and sustained intervention, global temperatures could rise by as much as 3 degrees Celsius above pre-industrial levels by the end of this century. The consequences of such warming, which include more frequent extreme weather events, rising sea levels, and disruptions to agricultural systems, would be felt disproportionately by vulnerable populations in developing nations.

questions.content: What is the main idea of the passage?

options.A: AI will definitely create more jobs than it eliminates.
options.B: AI technology has both positive and negative implications for society.
options.C: AI is only beneficial to industries that rely on repetitive tasks.
options.D: AI technology will soon replace all human workers.

A.explanation: 文中说proponents argue（支持者主张），并非definitely（确定），将可能变为必然

B.explanation: 文章既讲excitement又讲anxiety，既讲revolutionize又讲job displacement，全面概括正反两面

C.explanation: 文中说AI将revolutionize industries（颠覆各行业），并非only beneficial to repetitive tasks（仅对重复任务有益），缩小了范围

D.explanation: 文中说job displacement（岗位取代），并非replace all human workers（取代所有人类工人），过于绝对

steps: 识别题型：主旨题，需要概括全文核心观点
分析文章结构：第一句提出AI引发excitement和anxiety，中间分别论述正反两面，最后总结AI已成为现实并引发深层问题
排除A、D：过于绝对（definitely/all），与文中谨慎表述不符
排除C：缩小范围（only），文中讨论的是全行业影响
确认B：全面概括了文章正反两面的讨论，为主旨

questions.content: According to the passage, critics of AI are primarily concerned about:

options.A: The high cost of implementing AI systems.
options.B: The potential loss of jobs for workers doing repetitive tasks.
options.C: The lack of intelligence in current AI systems.
options.D: The slow pace of AI development.

A.explanation: 文中未提及AI实施成本（high cost），属于无中生有

B.explanation: 原文定位：Critics warn that...lead to widespread job displacement, particularly among workers whose roles involve routine, repetitive tasks

C.explanation: 文中未提及AI缺乏智能（lack of intelligence），属于无中生有

D.explanation: 文中说rapid deployment（快速部署），选项说slow pace（缓慢步伐），意思相反

steps: 识别题型：细节题，需要定位原文具体信息
定位关键词critics → 原文第二句Critics, however, warn that...
排除A、C：文中未提及成本和AI智能不足，无中生有
排除D：原文说rapid（快速），选项说slow（缓慢），正反混淆
确认B：与原文job displacement + repetitive tasks完全对应

questions.content: It can be inferred from the passage that:

options.A: Current efforts to reduce carbon emissions have been entirely sufficient.
options.B: Developing nations are more likely to suffer from the effects of climate change.
options.C: Global temperatures have already risen by 3 degrees Celsius.
options.D: Individuals play no role in addressing climate change.

A.explanation: 文中说the overall trajectory remains concerning（总体趋势令人担忧），选项说entirely sufficient（完全足够），意思相反

B.explanation: 推理依据：最后一句说consequences...would be felt disproportionately by vulnerable populations in developing nations（发展中国家将不成比例地承受后果），可推出发展中国家更可能受影响

C.explanation: 文中说could rise by as much as 3 degrees（可能上升多达3度），选项说have already risen（已经上升），将未来可能变为已发生

D.explanation: 文中说demanding coordinated action from...individuals alike（需要个人共同行动），选项说individuals play no role（个人不起作用），意思相反

steps: 识别题型：推理题，需要从文中信息合理推断
定位最后一句：consequences would be felt disproportionately by vulnerable populations in developing nations
排除A：原文说trajectory remains concerning，与sufficient矛盾
排除C：原文说could rise（可能上升），选项说already risen（已上升），偷换时态
排除D：原文说需要individuals行动，与no role矛盾
确认B：从disproportionately（不成比例地）可推出发展中国家受影响更大
